--src: Mathlib.SetTheory.Game.Nim
theorem exists_grundyValue_moveLeft_of_lt {G : PGame} {o : Nimber} (h : o < grundyValue G) :
    ∃ i, grundyValue (G.moveLeft i) = o := by
  rw [grundyValue_eq_sInf_moveLeft] at h
  by_contra ha
  exact h.not_le (csInf_le' ha)

--src: Mathlib.Data.PFunctor.Univariate.M
theorem M.default_consistent [Inhabited F.A] : ∀ n, Agree (default : CofixA F n) default
  | 0 => Agree.continu _ _
  | succ n => Agree.intro _ _ fun _ => M.default_consistent n

--src: Mathlib.Data.PFun
theorem dom_eq (f : α →. β) : Dom f = { x | ∃ y, y ∈ f x } :=
  Set.ext (mem_dom f)

--src: Mathlib.Data.Set.Basic
@[simp]
theorem sep_setOf : { x ∈ { y | p y } | q x } = { x | p x ∧ q x } :=
  rfl

--src: Mathlib.Data.Nat.PartENat
theorem find_dom (h : ∃ n, P n) : (find P).Dom :=
  h

--src: Mathlib.SetTheory.Nimber.Basic
instance small_Icc (a b : Nimber.{u}) : Small.{u} (Set.Icc a b) := Ordinal.small_Icc a b

--src: Mathlib.ModelTheory.Skolem
theorem exists_small_elementarySubstructure : ∃ S : L.ElementarySubstructure M, Small.{max u v} S :=
  ⟨Substructure.elementarySkolem₁Reduct ⊥, inferInstance⟩

--src: Mathlib.Computability.Partrec
theorem rfind_spec {p : ℕ →. Bool} {n : ℕ} (h : n ∈ rfind p) : true ∈ p n :=
  h.snd ▸ (rfindX p h.fst).2.1

--src: Mathlib.SetTheory.Game.PGame
/-- A small set of pre-games is bounded above. -/
lemma bddAbove_of_small (s : Set PGame.{u}) [Small.{u} s] : BddAbove s := by
  simpa using bddAbove_range_of_small (Subtype.val : s → PGame.{u})

--src: Mathlib.Data.Nat.Find
lemma le_findGreatest (hmb : m ≤ n) (hm : P m) : m ≤ Nat.findGreatest P n :=
  le_of_not_lt fun hlt => (findGreatest_eq_iff.1 rfl).2.2 hlt hmb hm

problem usa1978_p1 :
    IsGreatest { e : ℝ | ∃ a b c d : ℝ, IsGood a b c d e } max_e := by
  -- solution 3 from
  -- https://artofproblemsolving.com/wiki/index.php/1978_USAMO_Problems/Problem_1
  unfold IsGreatest IsGood max_e upperBounds
  constructor
  · simp only [Set.mem_setOf_eq]
    use (6 / 5)
    use (6 / 5)
    use (6 / 5)
    use (6 / 5)
    constructor <;> norm_num
  · simp only [Set.mem_setOf_eq]
    intro e
    contrapose!
    intro he a b c d
    intro h1 h2
    apply (not_le_of_gt he)
    have h11 : (a + b + c + d) ^ 2 = (8 - e) ^ 2 := by
      rw [(by rw [←h1]; simp only [add_sub_cancel_right] : a + b + c + d = 8 - e)]
    have h12 :  a ^ 2 + b ^ 2 + c ^ 2 + d ^ 2 = 16 - e ^ 2 := by
      rw [←h2]; simp only [add_sub_cancel_right]
    have h3 : (a - b)^2 + (a - c)^2 + (a - d)^2 +
              (b - c)^2 + (b - d)^2 + (c - d)^2 = 4 * (16 - e^2) - (8 - e)^2 := by
      linear_combination 4 * h12 - h11
    have h4 : 4 * (16 - e ^ 2) - (8 - e) ^ 2 ≥ 0 := by rw [←h3]; positivity
    revert h4
    rw [(by ring_nf : 4 * (16 - e ^ 2) - (8 - e) ^ 2 = e * (16 - 5 * e))]
    contrapose!
    intro _
    rw [mul_comm]
    apply mul_neg_of_neg_of_pos
    · linarith
    · positivity

goal: ⊢ IsGreatest (setOf fun e => Exists fun a => Exists fun b => Exists fun c => Exists fun d => Usa1978P1.IsGood a b c d e) Usa1978P1.max_e
